contentText:
Ponder the orb, but with a retro pixel-art vibe.

SwitchBot's new RGB desk light lets you put a teeny version of the Las Vegas Sphere in your home. The AI-powered Obboto lamp announced at CES is described by SwitchBot as an "expressive globe light companion" that can display preset animations and user-uploaded images and GIFs as pixel art, giving you a fun, customizable desktop lighting experience.

The SwitchBot Obboto includes more than 2,900 RGB LEDs and a motion sensor, responding to your movement or touch. Features include music visualization, AI-driven "mood animations," and dedicated modes for sleep, focus, relaxation, meditation, and everyday ambiance, according to SwitchBot's annou …

Read the full story at The Verge.
